<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">External Lighting</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of the development , an External Lighting Scheme shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be designed and implemented in accordance with the Bat Conservation Trust guidelines and must be sensitive to wildlife. The lighting design should ensure that: Harsh lighting is minimised to avoid making habitats (including the green roofs) unfavourable to local species, particularly bats and other nocturnal wildlife. The use of low-intensity lighting is prioritised, ensuring that any light sources do not directly illuminate bat roosts, foraging areas, or flight paths. All lighting fixtures are shielded or directed to limit light pollution and to maintain dark corridors that are critical for bat and wildlife movement. The approved lighting scheme shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the development and maintained thereafter in accordance with the approved details.</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;" id="docs-internal-guid-f07e559f-7fff-e408-e800-30eb32be2703"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure that the development provides the maximum provision towards the creation of </span><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve;">habitats for biodiversity and potential for this to impact on amenity. </span></p><div><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;"><br></span></div>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Tree Planting&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">A tree planting scheme illustrated on detailed drawings shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, prior to above ground works , for the planting of trees and shrubs showing species, size, type of stock, numbers of trees and shrubs to be included, tree pit specifications and an establishment and maintenance schedule; all landscaping in accordance with the scheme, when approved, shall be carried out prior to occupation&nbsp; or shall be carried out in the first planting season following occupation , and shall be maintained to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority for a period of ten years, such maintenance to include the replacement of any plants that die, or are severely damaged, seriously diseased, or removed.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-11586784-7fff-c22a-38f7-493033cbf977"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To accord with the requirements of Section 197(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 and to provide reasonable environmental standards in the interests of the appearance of the site and area.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Street Trees</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">All trees and planting immediately adjacent to the site shall be retained unless shown on the approved drawings as being removed. Any trees or planting indicated on the approved drawings which, within a period of five years from the date of planting, die, are removed or become seriously damaged, diseased or dying shall be replaced during the next planting season (October to March inclusive) with other trees or plants of a location, species and size to be first approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c4d1b667-7fff-42b8-fe71-4ee375b3e7ce"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: In the interests of visual amenity and wider environmental benefits, having regard to Policy LP51 in the Local Plan 2033 (adopted 2020).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Soft Landscaping</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to Occupation of the development phase, detailed design drawings of the hard and soft</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">landscaping scheme for the development shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The submission will be accompanied by confirmation of the final Urban Greening Factor score, and demonstration of a net gain. The information shall include, where relevant, details on plant/tree species and location (including number of plants of each species). All planting, seeding or turfing shall be implemented in the first planting season following first occupation of the relevant phase, as defined by the approved phasing plan. Any plants of trees that die or are removed, damaged or diseased within a period of ten years from the substantial completion of the development shall be replaced to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority in the next planting season with others of a similar size and species. All hard landscaping within the planning application red line boundary shall be carried out in full prior to occupation of the relevant phase of the development. The soft landscaping details required shall reflect the requirements of the Highway Works Contribution contained within the S106 agreement. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in full accordance with the details thus approved.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b4645f83-7fff-d37d-38ec-251599add147"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure that the external appearance of the site is acceptable and protects and enhances biodiversity, and in accordance with LP47 and LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan as well as Section 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Landscape and Ecological Management Plan&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the occupation of the development, a Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (LEMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The LEMP&nbsp; shall set out how the landscaping will be managed to support habitat creation and demonstrate a measurable Biodiversity Net Gain. It shall include a long-term management strategy detailing ownership, responsibilities, and maintenance schedules for all landscaped areas and the public realm. This shall cover elements such as weeding, mowing, irrigation, and green roof maintenance, and the management of trees and planting.</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;" id="docs-internal-guid-9f8bdf40-7fff-05cf-b9de-f726b86529b0"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">All landscaping works shall be carried out in full accordance with the approved details. These works shall either be completed prior to occupation of any part of the development or, if otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, during the first planting and seeding season following completion. All landscaping shall be maintained for the life of the development to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority. This maintenance shall include the replacement of any trees or plants that die, are removed, or become seriously damaged, diseased, or dying within ten years of planting, with specimens of the same species and size, unless otherwise agreed in writing.</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The approved LEMP shall be fully implemented prior to occupation of the development and maintained for the life of the development. Written notification shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority confirming when the landscaping and habitat creation works have been completed in accordance with the approved scheme.</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To protect, enhance and maintain the landscape features and character of the area, and in accordance with LP47 and LP51 of the Hackney Local Plan as well as Sections 15 of the National Planning Policy Framework.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Bird and Bat Boxes</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to occupation, a minimum of four bird and bat boxes or bricks will be installed at eaves level of buildings, with a variety of box/brick types suitable for use by different species. These will be</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">maintained for the lifespan of the development.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e32364da-7fff-ff99-0b9c-540ab137db9b"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To enhance local biodiversity by providing nesting opportunities for birds, including swifts and habitat for bats, in line with local policy to conserve nature and provide habitat for wildlife</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Urban Greening Factor</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the above ground works, a detailed Urban Greening Factor (UGF) Master Plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, demonstrating how the development will achieve a minimum UGF target score of 0.153. The submission must include a clearly colour-coded master plan identifying all surface cover types within the development. A completed UGF calculation table must be provided, detailing each surface cover type with its corresponding UGF value, the total area of each surface type, the weighted score for each feature, and the cumulative total UGF score for the site. The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation, and the greening features and soft landscaping must be maintained for the lifetime of the development unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-9f818526-7fff-487a-f1b0-ea00cb67dd13"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates appropriate urban greening measures to enhance biodiversity, mitigate urban heat effects and contribute to environmental sustainability, in accordance with Hackney's Local Plan LP48 and the London Plan, Policy G5.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Intensive Green Roofs&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the above ground works , detailed drawings and full specifications of the proposed intensive green/biodiverse roof shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submission shall include cross-sectional drawings (scale 1:20) confirming a minimum substrate depth of 150mm, excluding the vegetative mat; a planting plan incorporating a diverse mix of at least 30 species, including native species beneficial to local wildlife; and a management and maintenance plan to ensure the long-term success of the green roof. The approved details shall be fully implemented and retained thereafter.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e5bff85b-7fff-f8b4-003a-0db1ccd9d5f4"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To promote biodiversity on site through green roofs, in line with Hackney's Local Plan LP33, policy LP46.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Water Efficiency</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to above ground construction works, the applicant shall provide a statement to confirm that the development has been designed to be water efficient and reduce water consumption as far as possible, demonstrating that the residential development will not exceed a maximum water use of 105 litres of water per person per day, with an additional maximum water use allowance for external water consumption of 5 litres.</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;" id="docs-internal-guid-0fba5c2c-7fff-efe6-b12d-3b9d739d700a"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Strategy, evidence and supporting documentation should be provided and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to above ground works showing how water saving measures, recycling and water efficiency measures have been incorporated in the design to limit both internal and external water use and promote efficient water use.</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: Addressing the need to conserve water, to mitigate and adapt to climate change, taking into account the full range of potential climate change impacts in accordance with the London Plan, GLA guidance, Hackney Local Plan policy and the NPPF.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Parking Design and Management Plan (PDMP)&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to first occupation of the proposed development, details of the Parking, Design and Management Plan (PDMP) for that phase shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. The PDMP(s) shall:&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Demonstrate safe design of the agreed number of off-street car parking spaces (blue badge spaces within this scheme) and access for pedestrians and cyclists and minimisation of conflict between use groups; and Appropriate provision of blue badge parking and; and Include details of how additional blue badge car parking could be provided in future; and Permanent Mechanisms for prevention of non-car parking areas to be controlled for that purpose; and Ensure that use of car parking for the relevant block is actively controlled through measures to enforce the car parking arrangements for the relevant block</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The approved PDMP(s) shall be implemented in full prior to occupation of the phase of development, fully implemented for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-f2ad38bb-7fff-3a6f-b447-a0d2f6b07bb3"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: In the interests of highway safety and the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, and in accordance with LP41, LP42, LP44 and LP45 of the Hackney Local Plan and Section 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Cycle Parking&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the occupation of each phase of the development hereby permitted, full details of secure, accessible, on site bicycle storage including location, layout, stand type and spacing, shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority. Such details as approved shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development and shall thereafter be retained and maintained.</span></p><p><b style="font-weight:normal;" id="docs-internal-guid-3e654821-7fff-f85a-4daf-d325571ebcff"><br></b></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">To ensure that adequate provision of bicycle spaces is made within the development in the interests of discouraging car use, relieving congestion in surrounding streets, safeguarding&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure adequate cycle parking is provided for residents, employees and visitors in accordance with LP42 of the Hackney Local Plan and Appendix 2 (Cycle Parking Standards) of the Hackney Local Plan and Section 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework. </span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">&nbsp;Travel Plan&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to occupation of the residential and non-residential accommodation of each phase of development, a Travel Plan (TP) covering that phase shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The TP shall:&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Detail measures to encourage sustainable and active travel including the provision of local travel information and restrictions on car parking and vehicle use within the development to occupiers; and establish a long term management strategy with measurable targets and outcomes; and Include details of implementation, monitoring and regular review mechanisms; and Set out the measures to enforce the TP for the relevant block and/or building.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-8e11f036-7fff-a7de-0713-df4f73367b9e"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To promote sustainable transport and in the interests of highway safety, and in accordance with LP43 of the Hackney Local Plan, Section 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework. </span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Delivery &amp; Servicing Management Plan</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of the proposed development, details of the Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (DSMP) for both residential and commercial/community uses within that Block or Building shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the Local Planning Authority.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The DSMP(s) shall:</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Seek to rationalise the number of delivery and servicing with the aim of reducing traffic impacts for the relevant block; and</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Include, inter alia, details of the location and management of servicing areas; location, number and timings of deliveries and collections (which should avoid anti-social hours); the types of delivery and collection vehicles; and</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Ensure that delivery space and time for the relevant block is actively controlled through measures set out in the DSMP; and</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Set out the measures to enforce the servicing arrangements for the relevant block.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The approved DSMP(s) shall be fully implemented for the life of the development.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b9b48743-7fff-fba9-1074-39be65cf65b0"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: In the interests of highway safety and the amenity of neighbouring occupiers, and in accordance with LP43 of the Hackney Local Plan, Section 9 of the National Planning Policy Framework.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Secured by Design</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Prior to the first occupation of each building or part of a building or use, a 'Secured by Design' accreditation shall be obtained for such building or part of such building or use and thereafter all features are to be permanently retained.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a5d9e490-7fff-7721-beec-46dde39715d1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: To ensure development is delivered in accordance with secure by design principles in accordance with the Policy D11 of the London Plan and Hackney Local Plan Policy LP9.&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Sustainable Drainage Strategy&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:10pt;"><span style="font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">No development shall commence, other than works of demolition, until full detailed specifications of the sustainable drainage system supported by appropriate calculations, construction details, drainage layout and a site-specific management and maintenance plan of the sustainable drainage system have been provided.
